name: ReceiverAxelar spoofed expressExecute EYWA unlock
summary: ReceiverAxelar.expressExecute skipped Axelar gateway validation and trusted attacker-controlled sourceChain and sourceAddress, so the caller passed a spoofed receiveData payload that routed through PortalV2 into the CLP Portal and unlocked 999,787,453.0325354 EYWA to the caller in a single transaction.

loss.notes: Exact receipt accounting: one EYWA Transfer of 999787453.0325354 from the CLP Portal 0xac8f44ceca92b2a4b30360e5bd3043850a0ffcbe to the caller, priced at the 2026-02-01 CoinGecko daily close. This record anchors the largest single drain of a Nomad-style multi-attacker campaign totaling about $2.9m across chains; the 99,988.74 EYWA dust to fee collector 0x4400671b in the same transaction is not counted. No attacker-supplied campaign inputs besides gas.

ageReset.description: Directly deployed ReceiverAxelar runtime with the unvalidated expressExecute path since creation. No proxy code-selection path; the runtime hashes identically at deployment and immediately before the incident.

sources.note: Anchor: 0x37d9b911ef710be851a2e08e1cfc61c2544db0f208faeade29ee98cc7506ccc2 (block 24363854:49, 2026-02-01T18:38:23Z) is the single largest campaign drain, sent by 0x632400f42e96a5deb547a179ca46b02c22cd25cd directly to ReceiverAxelar 0xb2185950f5a0a46687ac331916508aada202e063 with an expressExecute-style payload naming Ethereum as source chain. The call trace shows ReceiverAxelar static-calling the gateway check, then calling PortalV2 0x0f00f1a6a3 which delegate-calls into the CLP implementation 0xf3792bae, ending in the CLP Portal 0xac8f44ceca92b2a4b30360e5bd3043850a0ffcbe transferring 999787453.0325354 EYWA to the caller; the recipient matches the team's published holder list. No compromised-key path is evidenced: expressExecute is permissionless and the spoofed payload passes the contract's own peer checks. Age: the ReceiverAxelar runtime was created directly by 0x89c0a6bf7723fba9d10b9365bfb447ebaf11c6b1 in 0x980e1be28070de4f3d509c96bb8f6eca9e553e3e11f87a68bd3081756d85c93d at block 23839786:151; no EIP-1967 implementation slot is set and eth_getCode at pre-exploit block 24363853 hashes 0x64fbe4fb9f7721b00e8e26138ede053b7fb917861e1965c3cfd311ba4358fcab identically to head, giving 1769971103 minus 1763636063 equals 6335040 seconds.
